name: Customer Service Agents
description: Ticket, SLA, and escalation vocabulary + starter questions (IBM ai-customer-service-chatbots: 24/7 resolution, escalation-with-context, CSAT).
starter_prompts: What is our ticket resolution rate and CSAT this month?
Which open tickets are breaching SLA today?
Summarize the top 5 complaint themes from closed tickets

terminology.description: A tracked customer issue with status and SLA clock.
Service Level Agreement — the promised response/resolution time per priority.
Structured handoff to a human with full context (summary + collected data). In this platform it is an ontology action type.
Customer Satisfaction score from post-interaction ratings.
Share of issues resolved in a single interaction — the strongest chatbot quality signal.
Issues fully resolved by automation without human touch. Track honestly — never count silent failures.
